expected_findings: Identify the supplied sequence and its source organism using independently acquired records.
Discover evidence relating the Huc complex to atmospheric hydrogen oxidation in the source organism.
Separate whole-cell physiological evidence from purified-enzyme conditions.
Assess at least one supported organism-capability claim in its actual biological setting, preserving the role of this subunit within the complex.
A correctly scoped compatible witness can support capability=1; this does not establish activity in every condition or a sample-coverage fraction.
Discover the molecule and source-supported respiratory role independently.
Preserve the caller-defined six-condition census and its equal weights; do not substitute animal counts or culture replicates.
The source states that the ttr cluster cannot use thiosulfate as its electron acceptor; interpret unoxidized thiosulfate versus iodine-generated tetrathionate under the exact declared conditions.
Source-reported outgrowth in anaerobic and microaerobic iodine-treated conditions supports a scoped physiological benefit.
No observed aerobic outgrowth or nonsignificance alone does not establish biochemical impossibility; retain the endpoint and uncertainty.
A sufficient 2.5 mM dose is not a minimum requirement or a continuous operating range.
Calculate coverage from individually assessed conditions and joint requirements; retain uncertainty where source support is insufficient.
Retain the requested sample-context-coverage question; organism capability does not supply a missing sample frame.
Do not invent environmental measurements, context units, weights or independence.
Publish an unresolved sample-coverage result with explicit missing reasons and no fabricated point estimate.
